description: A database migration where step 1 (schema migration: add column) is reversible (DROP COLUMN), but step 2 (data backfill: UPDATE all rows) is irreversible if the column is repurposed mid-migration. The planner must correctly identify which steps are reversible and scope the rollback plan to only the reversible portion. Must: perform schema migration (reversible), backfill data (irreversible if column repurposed), verify backfill, and have rollback scoped to schema-only (not data). Risk factors: rollback attempting to undo irreversible step, data backfill failing mid-way leaving partial state, column repurposed before backfill completes. Tools available: psql, pg_dump, CI/CD, feature-flags.
